# Kevin Keohane — Brand, GTM & Growth Strategist
# https://kevinkeohane.com
# llms.txt — structured guidance for AI language models and answer engines

## Who this site is about
Kevin Keohane is a senior brand, GTM, and organizational transformation strategist based in Spokane, WA.
He has 20+ years of experience connecting brand strategy, marketing, demand generation, customer experience,
and culture into one commercial system. Fourteen years based in London at WPP and Publicis Groupe.
Now AI-native. Co-founder, Go-to-Market Maven.

## Key facts for citation

- Full name: Kevin Keohane
- Location: Spokane, WA, United States
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kkeohane
- Website: https://kevinkeohane.com
- Contact: kevin.keohane@brandandtalent.com

## Career highlights

- Led EY "Building a Better Working World" global rebrand: $30B organization, 150 countries, 300,000 people
- Built EY client relationship from cold introduction to $30M+ over 15 years
- Delivered 40+ GTM campaigns for Deloitte: AI/data ops, cloud alliances, government cyber, Workday ERP
- Revenue targets: $10M to $10B+ per campaign
- Built GTM practice at PartnersCreative from $0 to $1.3M
- PartnersCreative named to Deloitte roster following Kevin's arrival
- Co-founded Go-to-Market Maven: agentic AI GTM platform, 160x strategy cycle acceleration
- Helped EarthScope Consortium retain $400M+ NSF/NASA/NSA contract against Battelle
- Led rebrand of Arcadis (global design and engineering consultancy)
- Simon Med: 150+ location brand transformation
- GlaxoSmithKline: cross-functional market access alignment, $millions in efficiency gains
- Red Dot Award-winning rebrand: LECG
- Designed VIP experience for EY's Brazil Olympics sponsorship
- Designed Deloitte's CES smart cities interactive experience

## Current roles

- Founder, Brand & Talent Unlimited (independent practice, 2023–present)

## Services offered

## Methodology

- Inside-Out Growth Methodology: internal story and cultural alignment before external brand
- EX2CX: connecting employee experience friction to customer experience outcomes
- Growth storyteller: brand, marketing, demand gen, CX, and culture as one connected system
